title: Reduce and migrate local achievement progress from verified session summaries
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md and the referenced frozen docs/design sources. Rules Spec v1 is canonical: Repair/Sabotage each end at six, one direct player-card vote, private Route/Gate inputs and authoritative deterministic outcomes. The five-point/Witness/demo scripts and completed T01-T10 APIs are historical; preserve their existing tests/API compatibility without using them as new game rules. Edit only owned paths and use existing dependencies unless manifest ownership explicitly permits reviewed additions. Keep engine production pure and do not read credentials, provision services, deploy, publish PRs or start agents. Use original synthetic fixtures and verified assets only. Run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check; report outcomes and contract changes. Implement a pure achievement-progress reducer and versioned local persistence. Accept only trusted SoloAuthority events or authenticated multiplayer result summaries through an explicit source boundary. Deduplicate event and match IDs, track approved progress across sessions, and never unlock from an unverified role assertion or premature private state. Do not add accounts, cloud sync or premium tracks. Conceal secret names until their approved unlock condition is verified. Retain only privacy-safe recent-match aggregates rather than another player's identity or history.
acceptance: Each enabled catalogue predicate has independent positive/negative tests, and duplicate delivery cannot grant progress twice.
Only approved finalized events or summaries can grant achievements based on secret roles or match wins.
Storage migration preserves prior progress, rejects corrupt or unknown data safely, and does not persist other players' secrets.
No login, paid progress, coins, rarity tiers or unlock-gated gameplay is introduced.
